newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dollar demand.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed lower against the U.S. currency on Sunday amid active dollar purchases by some private banks, dealers said.
Taka finished at 44.2050/2100 per dollar against a previous close at 44.2020/2050

Dealers also said tight selling of the U.S. currency by both state-owned and foreign banks kept the local unit under pressure. A few early deals were done at 44.2000 per dollar but most late deals were at the 44.2100 level.
The interbank call money rates closed lower at 7.0 to 7.5 percent against the previous 8.0-8.5 percent.
